answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the ledge fee to keep them eligible. Because the delta decay is applied at each close, the ferrous audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 31% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
